message.content: The Python state does not persist between calls, so I'll put the physics functions in a module file and import it.
message.reasoning: It looks like state doesn't persist across calls—each one seems like a fresh process, though files in the working directory do stick around. So my plan is to write a persistent module file, like /tmp/work/phys.py, holding all the functions, and just import it each time instead of redefining everything.
